Hi Alex,

Thanks for taking this. We're starting our vendor security review for the coming quarter and need to confirm Redwood's SOC 2 Type II coverage and get a short list of targeted control artifacts to complete our assessment. High-level asks: 

- Please confirm the SOC 2 Type II report period (start/end dates) and whether Redwood will provide a bridge letter covering any gap between the report end-date and today.
- We need a short set of control exhibits beyond the report focused on authentication and access: MFA enforcement policy + evidence of enforcement during the audit period, an access-review attestation for privileged accounts, and an example extract of auth logs (timestamped) for a week-long slice.
- Any pre-authorized mechanism to get those artifacts (SFTP, secure Drive link, or signed NDA/Docs) would be helpful.

Attached is our SIG/CAIQ-lite so you can see the fields we expect. Our security team will treat all artifacts as confidential. Can you confirm what you can deliver and an ETA?

Emma — thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers first, then proposed next steps: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report period: 2024-05-01 to 2025-04-01.
2) Bridge letter: yes — we can provide a SOC 2 bridge letter that covers the period 2025-04-02 through the date of delivery.
3) Targeted control artifacts: we can provide the following slices and attestations:
   - MFA enforcement: policy PDF + enforcement metrics and a time-bound MFA enforcement log slice (CSV) for a requested window.
   - Access reviews: attestation notes from the access review owner for privileged groups (IAM-Admins, Infra-Ops) and export of last recert cycle.
   - Auth logs: an example one-week auth log extract (redacted PII) showing timestamps, subject, source IP, outcome, and MFA flag.

To expedite, please confirm the exact audit window you want for the auth-log slice. Our SOC 2 window ends 2025-04-01, so common requests are either: (a) the audit period week (e.g., 2024-10-01 — 2025-03-31 sample week), or (b) a recent one-week window to demonstrate current enforcement (e.g., 2025-03-24 — 2025-03-30). Once you confirm, we will prepare the CSV slice and the bridge-letter draft.

Delivery options: we can share via a secured Drive folder (Doc-level access, expiring links), or via a pre-authorized SFTP drop if you prefer. For anything that contains sensitive session logs, we will redact PII and provide a short explanation of the redaction approach.

ETA: If you confirm the log window today, we can deliver the policy + bridge-letter draft + access-review attestation within 3 business days; log slices may take 5 business days depending on scope.

Regards,
Alex Martinez
Customer Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai
